switch(stat)
case -1: gsys_log("ioexp: i2c bus busy")
case -2: gsys_log("ioexp: i2c 0 length error")
case -3: gsys_log("ioexp: i2c timeout error")
case -4: gsys_log("ioexp: i2c NACK received error")
